comment: The eight step knobs are configured with no name of their own, so their tooltips read just the voltage; the census shows them as blank. Each row's button and its jack are the same event, so a row can be fired by hand or by a trigger. The clip switch is a four-way, starting at ±10V. Reset exists so that going home does not cost a row: a jump row with its knob at zero would do the same job but would spend a whole row on it. The maker names cumuli as the continuous counterpart of this module. The panel numbers the rows 1 to 8 from the top and marks the two trigger columns + and - at the top.
